Lexie (Fomalhaut), docs/FORTUNA_LEXIE.md 2026-11-19: the 'most beautiful planet' look (Modern style). Physically motivated, exaggerated where noted: turquoise carbonate banks (karst 1.0, carbonate 15 %: Bahamas-like white sand under clear water) kept turquoise down to ~1 km depth (exaggerated); deep oligotrophic sapphire sea; sharper, brighter glint (1.4 bar calm swell, a hot white star); vegetation under an A3 star (more blue/UV: pigments plausibly absorb blue -> teal-emerald forests, golden meadows, Kiang 2007 speculation); pink coralline sands (Bermuda-like) on dry coasts; night: bioluminescent 'milky sea' patches (real, satellite-observed) and blue surf rims; airglow green O 557.7 nm + gold Na 589 nm (strong day-side UV of an A star, sodium from the heavy dust infall of the young system) as a band on the night limb; aurorae green with crimson tops round a pole 9 deg off the spin axis (field 1.28 Earth); violet-leaning Rayleigh sky under an 8600 K star.
